title: Fix MultiSigWallet confirmation race condition during execution callback

fixes.description: Added nonReentrant modifier to executeTransaction to prevent confirmation revocation during callback
Added ConfirmationInfo struct with blockNumber and timestamp tracking; added isConfirmedAtBlock function
Added zero-address check and code-size validation in submitTransaction
Re-check confirmation count inside executeTransaction after execution lock, preventing front-running via revocation
Added duplicate owner check and zero-address validation in constructor

tests.description: Verify reentrancy guard blocks nested executeTransaction calls
Verify transaction cannot execute if confirmation revoked during execution
Verify isConfirmedAtBlock returns correct state at historical blocks
Verify executeTransaction gas stays under 100,000 for simple ETH transfer
Submit, confirm, execute — end-to-end happy path
